meta.title: Portfolio Check + $2K Plan — Sep 18, 2026
meta.headline: One stock made all your money. The next $2K should not go to it.
meta.thesis: The rate hike already happened on Sep 16. Rather than all-in or all-out, this plan stages the $2,000 around the Oct 28 Fed meeting and the Nov 3 midterms.

honest_read: AMD (+$704) is the whole gain. AVGO and NBIS are both below your cost. That is a {{?Concentration}} fact, not a reason to add to the winner.
